title: Malabar spinach Nutrient Deficiency: Signs, Causes and the Fertilizer That Fixes It
metaTitle: Malabar spinach Nutrient Deficiency: Signs and Fixes
metaDescription: Malabar spinach nutrient deficiency shows in the leaves. See the signs of nitrogen and potassium in alugbati, how to be sure, and the fertilizer to apply.
excerpt: Malabar spinach nutrient deficiency is one of the first things to check when the leaves of your alugbati (malabar spinach) turn yellow, purple or burnt at the edges. On Philippine farms the usual ones are nitrogen, potassium, phosphorus, magnesium and iron. This guide shows where each one starts, how to be sure, and the fertilizer that fixes it.

blocks.text: Start with one question: did the change begin on the old leaves or on the young ones? Nitrogen, potassium, phosphorus and magnesium move inside the plant, so a shortage shows on the old, lower leaves first. But iron stay where the plant first put them, so the young leaves and the growing tip show it first. After that, the color and the pattern narrow down which malabar spinach nutrient deficiency you have, and a soil test confirms it. Each one below has its signs, its causes and its fix.

blocks.text: Before you buy fertilizer for a malabar spinach nutrient deficiency

So use the table to pick the likeliest malabar spinach nutrient deficiency, then read its section below. Also keep in mind that dry soil, standing water, cold nights, a pest or a disease can look the same. That is why it pays to check the roots and the whole field first.
Nitrogen deficiency in malabar spinach

Older leaves fade to yellowish green and then yellow, and new shoots are thin, hard and slow to regrow after each harvest. Leaves stay small and the plant flowers early. You see it most at this stage: mid growth and the regrowth after each harvest.
Why nitrogen deficiency happens in alugbati
Repeated harvests that remove nitrogen with the shoots, sandy soils, heavy watering and low organic matter.
How to tell it apart
Root knot nematodes, which alugbati is weak against, also stunt and yellow plants. Check the roots for galls. To be sure, soil test for organic matter and nitrogen. Get a soil test for N, P and K.
What to apply for nitrogen deficiency

Top dress urea at half to one bag (25 to 50 kg) per hectare after each harvest. Both guides also side dress manure or compost once a month at 20 to 30 bags per hectare, or drench diluted manure tea (1 part to 20 parts water).

Sold here with nitrogen: **Atlas Granular Urea** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (46 0 0), **YaraVera Viking Ship Granular Urea** by Yara Fertilizers Philippines, Inc. (46 0 0), **Planters Products Granular Urea** by Planters Products, Inc. (46 0 0) and **Harbest Granular Urea** by Harbest Agribusiness Corporation (46 0 0). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [urea fertilizer](/blog/urea-fertilizer), and the page on [nitrogen deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/nitrogen-deficiency) in every crop. In anee.io, Anee, the [smart farm technician](/features/ai-agricultural-technician), reads a photo of the leaf and tells you which nutrient is short.
To keep it away, apply compost or manure at 3 to 5 tonnes per hectare when preparing the plots, as both guides advise.
Potassium deficiency in malabar spinach

Older leaves turn greyish green then bronze or yellowish brown, and the edges brown and cup down with specks along the veins. Stems are slender and roots weak. You see it most at this stage: later harvests.
Why potassium deficiency happens in alugbati
Sandy soils, heavy watering that leaches nutrients (so do not over irrigate), and feeding with urea only.
How to tell it apart
Leaf spot from Cercospora or Colletotrichum makes round spots across the leaf, not edge burn. To be sure, soil test for potassium.
What to apply for potassium deficiency
Use complete 14 14 14 or muriate of potash based on the soil test. A usual budget is 6 bags of 14 14 14 per hectare. Follow the soil test for the rate.

Sold here with potassium: **Atlas Muriate of Potash** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (0 0 60), **Philphos Muriate of Potash** by Philippine Phosphate Fertilizer Corporation (0 0 60), **Harbest Granular Muriate of Potash** by Harbest Agribusiness Corporation (0 0 60) and **Swire Muriate of Potash** by Swire Agrotech Agricultural Products Inc. (0 0 60). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [potash fertilizer](/blog/potash-fertilizer), and the page on [potassium deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/potassium-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, feed complete fertilizer, not only urea, and keep adding compost.
Phosphorus deficiency in malabar spinach

Growth is held back without yellowing. Stems are slender and leaves are small and darker green, and some leaves show a reddish purple tint underneath. Cuttings are slow to establish. You see it most at this stage: establishment of cuttings or seedlings.
Why phosphorus deficiency happens in alugbati
Acid or iron rich soils, low organic matter, and no phosphorus at planting.
How to tell it apart
The red stemmed alugbati is naturally purplish. Judge by growth, not color alone. To be sure, soil test for available phosphorus and pH.
What to apply for phosphorus deficiency
Use complete 14 14 14 at planting based on the soil test, and add compost. Follow the soil test for the rate.

Sold here with phosphorus: **Triple Super Phosphate** by Newman Chemicals Corporation (0 46 0), **Sagrex Duofos Granular Guano Phosphate** by Sagrex Corporation (0 22 0 (guano phosphate)), **Philphos 18 46 0** by Philippine Phosphate Fertilizer Corporation (18 46 0 (diammonium phosphate)) and **Atlas Di Ammonium Phosphate** by Atlas Fertilizer Corporation (18 46 0). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [16 20 0 fertilizer](/blog/16-20-0-fertilizer), and the page on [phosphorus deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/phosphorus-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, apply compost or manure at 3 to 5 tonnes per hectare during plot preparation.
Magnesium deficiency in malabar spinach

Older leaves turn yellow between the veins while the veins stay green. Leaves become brittle with upturned edges, and some plants show reddish purple color instead of yellow. You see it most at this stage: after several harvests.
Why magnesium deficiency happens in alugbati
Acid soils, heavy potash, and liming with plain lime only.
How to tell it apart
Nitrogen shortage yellows the whole leaf. To be sure, soil test for magnesium, potassium and pH.
What to apply for magnesium deficiency
Spray magnesium sulfate on the leaves and correct acid soil with dolomite. Follow the soil test for rates.

Sold here with magnesium: **Dolomite** by A6 Agrisource Limited Corporation (24 percent calcium and 11 percent magnesium), **YaraTera KRISTA MgS** by Yara Fertilizers Philippines, Inc. (16 percent MgO and 13 percent sulfur), **Magnepro** by Ramgo International Corporation (16 percent MgO and 12.8 percent sulfur) and **Lucky Planters Magnesium Sulphate Heptahydrate (Epsom Salt)** by Mindanao Agriplus Corporation (16.27 percent MgO and 13 percent sulfur). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [complete fertilizer](/blog/complete-fertilizer-14-14-14), and the page on [magnesium deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/magnesium-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, use dolomite on acid beds.
Iron deficiency in malabar spinach

New leaves turn light yellow between the veins, then over the whole leaf, usually without dead spots, while older leaves stay green. You see it most at this stage: any stage on alkaline or heavily limed soil.
Why iron deficiency happens in alugbati
Alugbati is grown on soils up to pH 8. The PNW handbook notes iron shortage is mostly a problem of alkaline or overlimed soils.
How to tell it apart
Nitrogen shortage starts on the older leaves. To be sure, soil pH test.
What to apply for iron deficiency
Stop liming and spray ferrous sulfate or iron chelate on the leaves. Follow the product label.

Sold here with iron: **Ferrous Sulphate Heptahydrate** by Cleveland Industries Inc. (20 percent iron), **Ferrous Sulfate Monohydrate** by Zetryl.Chem Phils., Inc. (30 percent iron), **Grow More Liquid Chelate Iron with Sulfur** by Sagrex Corporation (5 percent iron and 3 percent sulfur) and **Biozome** by Manchem Industries, Inc. (12 percent S, 12 percent Zn, 3 percent Mn, 1 percent Mg, 1 percent Fe, 1 percent Cu, 0.5 percent B, 0.05 percent Mo). Check the FPA registration on the bag and follow the label rate. For the how and when, see our guide to [foliar fertilizer](/blog/foliar-fertilizer), and the page on [iron deficiency](/nutrient-deficiencies/iron-deficiency) in every crop.
To keep it away, do not overlime, and add compost, which helps keep iron available.

blocks.title: Let a soil test decide the rate
blocks.text: A soil test is the surest check for any malabar spinach nutrient deficiency. Before you buy, ask your Municipal Agriculture Office where to send a soil sample. The DA regional soil laboratories test soil, and the result says how much of each fertilizer your alugbati needs. That saves money, because extra fertilizer is money lost.

blocks.text: Malabar spinach nutrient deficiency questions

items.q: Why are my alugbati leaves turning yellow?
items.a: The most common cause is nitrogen deficiency: older leaves fade to pale yellow and new shoots come thin and slow after cutting. If the young leaves turn yellow first instead, look at iron deficiency.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes nitrogen deficiency in malabar spinach?
items.a: Top dress urea at half to one bag (25 to 50 kg) per hectare after each harvest. Both guides also side dress manure or compost once a month at 20 to 30 bags per hectare, or drench diluted manure tea (1 part to 20 parts water).

items.q: What fertilizer fixes potassium deficiency in malabar spinach?
items.a: Use complete 14 14 14 or muriate of potash based on the soil test. A usual budget is 6 bags of 14 14 14 per hectare.

items.q: What fertilizer fixes phosphorus deficiency in malabar spinach?
items.a: Use complete 14 14 14 at planting based on the soil test, and add compost. Follow the soil test for the rate.

items.q: How do I know which nutrient my alugbati lacks?
items.a: First look at where the change began, on the old leaves or the young ones, then at the color and the pattern. Next, confirm the malabar spinach nutrient deficiency with a soil test or a leaf test before you buy fertilizer.
